name: The Walking Dead Secret Lair
description: A Secret Lair drop tying in with The Walking Dead franchise, made of new cards and later part of Universes Beyond.

description_citations.text: "The Walking Dead". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Walking Dead Secret Lair is offered for pre-order from October 4th through October 12th, 2020.
timeline.quote: It became available for pre-order purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com from October 4th through October 12th, 2020.

citation.text: "The Walking Dead". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The drop abandons the premise of Secret Lairs being only reprints with alternate art.
timeline.quote: With this drop, the premise of only reprints with alternate art for Secret Lairs was abandoned.

citation.text: "The Walking Dead", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The drop draws heavy fan criticism for featuring unique cards rather than reprints, but becomes the best-selling drop.
timeline.quote: the Walking Dead was the best selling drop, luring in buyers from outside of the Magic world.

citation.text: "The Walking Dead", section "Controversy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Replaced the usual bonus card as the drop's bonus.
relations.quote: It was replaced by a legendary artifact called Lucille ( Negan's weapon of choice) with art by Jason Felix.

citation.text: "The Walking Dead", section "Bonus card". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
